meta.title: PHP
meta.tagline: The web's most popular server-side language — powering 77% of websites.
meta.description: PHP is the most widely-used server-side language powering ~77% of websites including WordPress, Facebook and Wikipedia. Modern PHP (8.x) offers typed properties, enums, fibers and excellent performance.
